updates.title: Creator fees in the right coin
updates.text: On the token page of a four.meme or Flap coin that has left its curve and trades against a token such as USDT, the Creator fee is now counted in that token. It was counted as the chain's own coin, BNB or ETH, so its dollars could be far off.

updates.title: Creator fees
updates.text: The Pulse and the token page now show what a coin's creator has been paid from its trades so far, as Nesty's server counts it from the chain: F under the volume in the Pulse, for coins whose creator has been paid, and Creator fee on the token page. Both are in dollars at the current price of what the coin trades against. It covers four.meme and Flap coins with a tax, Pons, Stockereum and Montra; fees a launchpad still holds count once they are paid out.

updates.title: Holder figures for older coins
updates.text: Nesty's server now also follows the older coins in the Pulse on Robinhood and Elysium, counting every transfer since their launch, so their Holders tab lists every holder and the Pulse shows their holders and Top 10, creator, sniper and bundler shares at once.

updates.title: Faster holder figures in the Pulse
updates.text: The Pulse now takes a coin's holders and its Top 10, creator, sniper and bundler shares from Nesty's server wherever it has counted every transfer since the coin's launch, so those coins show them at once instead of after the page reads their whole history. For other coins, the page asks the chain what the wallets that bought at the launch hold now, and reads the rest itself.
